address.title: Address
address.description: Docker daemon address: a Unix socket (`unix://` and a path) or a TCP endpoint (`tcp://` and a host and port).

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Docker API request timeout, in seconds.

container_selector.title: Container selector
container_selector.description: Names of the containers that get their own charts, as a [simple pattern](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/tree/master/src/libnetdata/simple_pattern#readme). The totals count every container.

collect_container_size.title: Collect writable layer size
collect_container_size.description: Adds a chart of each container's writable layer size. Docker computes the sizes on every collection, which can cost the daemon significant CPU and disk I/O.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

address.ui:help: When the address is left at the default and the Agent's environment sets `DOCKER_HOST`, the collector connects to `DOCKER_HOST` instead. The Netdata container image sets it automatically.

timeout.ui:help: Accepts decimals for precise control (e.g., type 1.5 for 1.5 seconds).

container_selector.ui:help:
Separate patterns with spaces and prefix a pattern with `!` to exclude the names it matches; the first matching pattern decides. For example, `!test-* *` charts every container except those whose names start with `test-`.

A container labeled `netdata.cloud/ignore=true` gets no charts of its own, whatever the selector matches.

autodetection_retry.ui:help: The job fails to start when the Docker daemon is not running or its socket is not accessible. Set a retry interval if Docker may start after Netdata.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define the Virtual Node in `vnodes.conf` first, then enter its name here.
